sources: Esri World Imagery z16/z17 over Churchbridge (viewed)

values.note: Town of Churchbridge 2026: electric sites C$30 a night, non-electric C$20; weekly C$175, monthly C$600, seasonal C$1500.

fees.source: https://churchbridge.com/visitors/campground/ ('CHURCHBRIDGE CAMPGROUND – 2026 ... Non-electrical site $20 per night Electrical site $30 per night Weekly $175 Monthly $600 Seasonal $1500'), read 2026-11-18

sites.source: https://churchbridge.com/visitors/campground/ ('33 sites, 29 of which are pull-through sites equipped with 30 amp electrical service. The remaining sites are reserved for tents.'), read 2026-11-18

hookups.source: https://churchbridge.com/visitors/campground/ ('The Churchbridge Campground does not offer full water and sewer hookup at each site. There are, however, 3 potable water taps located throughout the campground'), read 2026-11-18

facilities.source: https://churchbridge.com/visitors/campground/ ('The campground offers hot showers, a modern washroom, and firewood'; '3 potable water taps'; 'the Sewage Disposal Station is free for campground tenants'), read 2026-11-18

booking.source: https://churchbridge.com/visitors/campground/ ('NO RESERVATIONS . The Churchbridge Campground operates on a first-come first-serve basis as it is monitored by volunteers.'), read 2026-11-18

note: Town of Churchbridge campground on the south edge of town along Highway 80 South (Raikes Street South), south of Highway 16; tree-lined pull-through lanes beside a ball diamond and covered picnic shelter. Volunteers check campers in and collect payment each evening (cash, cheque or e-transfer). --Claude
summary: Keep. Town campground, FCFS, 29 pull-through 30 A electric + 4 tent = 33; C$30/C$20 (2026), open May 19-Oct 14, 2026; no water/sewer at sites (3 taps, free dump), showers. PIN MOVE ~800 m: stored point is on a residential block in town.
